newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EU economy committee to meet in Lisbon Jun 26-27. [CORRECTED 23:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EU economy committee to meet in Lisbon Jun 26-27. [CORRECTED 23:10 GMT]

text.p: The political economy committee of the European Council will meet in Lisbon for the first time on June 26-27, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The committee is the consultative organ for the Council and reviews the economies of member states.

handling.status: Corrects headline and first paragraph to make clear that the committee involved was the political economy committee and not the monetary policy committee. Also makes clear that the committee belongs to the European Council and not Commission.
